sampling: Cells area-filtered to no larger than the smallest 16:9 HUD footprint; one mip, no minification. Watermark cells are area-filtered premultiplied with a coverage curve that keeps the measured ink band's edge rows at full alpha, and are packed with a one-pixel transparent gutter away from the sheet edge. The sb3 highlight cell is a white specular mask, not team colour; the wing and plate remain coverage cells the native tints multiply. The sb3 rim cells are white coverage; the runtime lifts the wing shade for the rail, and the wing and plate remain coverage cells the native tints multiply. The sb3 rim cells are white coverage; the runtime lifts the wing shade for the rail, and the wing and plate remain coverage cells the native tints multiply. The sb4 capsule is white body with two measured dividers; its red state is the same right cap, and the plate is a tapered neutral tab.
